item.text:
Fixed the gate failure.

Changed the trigger damage recipient grammar to accept `the <permanent>'s controller` alongside the existing `that <permanent>'s controller`, and normalized both to the existing `TriggerDamageRecipient::ThatPermanentController` path in the parser.

Verification:
- `cargo fmt --all`
- `cargo test -p mtg-grammar --test generated creature_bond::round_trip`
- `cargo test -p mtg-grammar --test generated`
- `cargo test`

All passed.
